page.layout: One column of running text, with a short continuation at the top, a rule, a centred heading in capitals and spaced type, and the body paragraph below. No marginal notes. Printed page number and running head at the top. Gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: Vel etiam per ellipsin præpositionis in versione supplendæ legere possis populo suo, seu propter populum suum, ut nempe populo Dei commoda paratur sedes, in quâ pietati sincerioris-que fidei professioni vacare possit.
main_text.head: DEMONSTRATIO VALORIS ARGUMENTORUM.
main_text.p: Quid de fine seu scopo dictorum, in ultimâ cantici hujus scenâ allatorum, censendum sit? vel ex ipso epiphonemate, aliisque enunciatis interpositis facile constat: nempe rupem salutis in omnibus viis hic expositis se probaturam veram rupem, seu omnipotentem Deum, mundi rectorem, & ecclesiæ assertorem fidelissimum. Concipitur causa ejus non solum à Judæis damnata, sed etiam à gentibus rejecta, & ab Antitrinitariis pertinaciter disceptata, qui omnes ejus magnitudinem, seu summam & independentem Deitatem non agnoscerent. Methodus autem disceptationis Rupis, pro suâ dignitate decertantis [?], ponitur in adversariorum judiciis, quæ totidem damnatæ adversariorum causæ argumenta forent, non quidem statim ob hominum quorundam inconsiderantiam, quoad valorem suum agnoscenda, sed tamen ab aliis tam vocatis, quam nomen Christi mentientibus admittenda, donec omnibus judiciis consummatis

page.notes: The initial "Q" of "Quid" is a woodcut ornamental initial, read as Q. "decertantis" is read from a soft impression and marked [?]. The word "consummatis" is cut at the foot of the scan; "matis" is the visible end. A stray asterisk before "quam" is printer's ink, not text, and is left out. Show-through from the reverse is not transcribed.
